label: Confirmed Deaths
contestNote: Toll held flat at 127 for four days (3-6 Sep) before BNPB chief Suharyanto reported it to President Prabowo as 135 on 7 September — split for the first time into 48 direct deaths (structural collapse, falling debris) and 87 indirect deaths (health complications, pre-existing conditions, other natural causes). BNPB has not published case-by-case documentation for the indirect-death classification. The figure remains unreconciled with BPBD NTT's competing 130 count from 5 September.

label: Displaced / Sheltering
contestNote: BNPB chief Suharyanto reported displacement at just 72,864 to President Prabowo on 7 September — a sharp drop from BNPB's own 166,829 figure (3-5 Sep) and well below even BPBD NTT's competing 96,385 count from 5 September. No agency has published a methodology explaining the scale or speed of the decline; treated as the tracker's current best figure since it is BNPB's own latest report, but with the caveat that neither prior figure has been formally reconciled.
delta: -93,965 since 3 Sep (166,829→72,864, per BNPB briefing to President Prabowo, 7 Sep)

label: Homes Damaged
contestNote: BNPB's Data Center now puts total identified damaged housing units at 102,384, of which 51,591 (50.39%) have completed field verification as of 7 September: 2,382 severely damaged, 7,276 moderately damaged, 14,177 lightly damaged and 27,756 confirmed undamaged after inspection. This supersedes BPBD NTT's narrower 99,568 provincial tally (4 Sep); verification remains ongoing and figures are described by BNPB as dynamic.

label: Aftershocks Recorded
deltaNote: M0.6–M6.2 range; 12,438 (BPBD NTT) / 12,064 (BNPB) by 5 September, rising to a cumulative 13,156 by 7 September. Weekly activity has fallen sharply — only 364 tremors recorded in the fourth week that were not significantly felt by residents — the clearest sign yet of the decay trend BMKG forecast tapering out within 21-30 days of the mainshock, a window now largely elapsed.

label: Presidential Visit Status
deltaNote: Twice-postponed visit finally took place on Day 11 (26 Aug); Prabowo distributed Rp200 billion in aid at a Nagekeo Regency command post.

label: Personnel Deployed
delta: 5,832 TNI + 238 Polri + 903 volunteers as of 22-23 Aug (up from 3,500+ TNI/Polri on 17 Aug)

label: State of Emergency
deltaNote: Governor Emanuel Melkiades Laka Lena extended the province-wide emergency response status by 14 days beyond its original 28 August expiry, citing forecast aftershock activity continuing another 2-3 weeks; Nagekeo Regency received a separate 3-month extension.

label: Mainshock Magnitude
contestNote: GFZ Potsdam measured Mw 7.61 at 25 km depth vs. USGS/BMKG's M7.7 at 10 km; BMKG's own first report was M7.0 before revising upward.

label: Schools Damaged
contestNote: BPBD NTT's provincial tally rose to 2,633 education units damaged as of 4 September (up from 2,310 on 2 September), still higher than Kemendikdasmen's own 1,918-unit assessment from 31 August (665 schools severely damaged, ~141,207 students affected, only 37 back to in-person classes and 295 on distance learning). A companion Kemendikdasmen breakdown put severely damaged classrooms at 6,927, with 418 laboratories, 1,928 toilets and 370 teacher residences also damaged, and 48,164 school-community members displaced; 785 schools had requested emergency classroom units (2,908 needed), only 89 emergency tents were installed as of 30 August, and 1,221 schools remained halted from in-person learning. Provincial and ministry counts have not yet been reconciled.

label: Aid Distributed (Cumulative)
deltaNote: Up from 1,954 tons (31 Aug); now distributed through the Labuan Bajo and Maumere entry points as the response shifts from emergency relief into the rehabilitation-reconstruction phase.
